o:a_p: I-VideoLAN yaqala njengephrojekthi yabafundi e-Paris yase ikhula yaba ngomunye wemiphakathi emikhulu ye-open source multimedia emhlabeni. Namuhla iqhutshwa ngamavolontiya nebhodi elincane, ixhaswe ngeminikelo nabalingani, futhi isebenzela abasebenzisi bayo kuphela.
o:desc: I-VideoLAN yinhlangano engenzi nzuzo engemuva kwe-VLC media player nomndeni wamaphrojekthi e-open source multimedia: dav1d, x264, libVLC, libdvdcss, libbluray, DVBlast nokunye.

o:f_x264: I-software video encoder edume kakhulu emhlabeni, esekela ingxenye enkulu yamavidiyo aku-inthanethi.

o:p_p: I-VLC yiyona eyaziwa kakhulu, kodwa i-VideoLAN inakekela amaphrojekthi e-open source angu-{n}: ama-codec, imitapo yolwazi yama-disc namathuluzi okusakaza anika amandla iziphequluli, amasistimu okusebenza, izinsiza zokusakaza namanethiwekhi e-TV.
o:pe_p: Ababambiqhaza abaqanjiwe abangu-{n} kukhodi, ukuhumusha, imidwebo nemibhalo, abavela emazweni angaphezu kwangama-40, abahlangana minyaka yonke kuma-VideoLAN Dev Days.
o:st_p: Noma ngabe awukaze uvule i-VLC, maningi amathuba okuthi ikhodi ye-VideoLAN yikona okwenze i-decode, i-encode noma kwathwala ividiyo yokugcina oyibukile. Nansi indlela izingxenye ezihlangana ngayo.
o:t1996_d: Abafundi base-École Centrale Paris baqala i-VideoLAN ukuze basakaze ividiyo kuyo yonke inethiwekhi yekhempasi.
o:t1998_d: Ikhodi ibhalwa kabusha kusukela ekuqaleni, ibeka izisekelo ze-VLC yanamuhla.
o:t2001_d: Ngomhlaka 1 kuFebhuwari, i-École iyavuma ukukhipha yonke into ngaphansi kwe-GNU GPL.
o:t2004_d: Umsebenzi uqala ku-x264, eba yi-encoder yereferensi ye-H.264.
o:t2008_d: Umphakathi uhlangana e-Paris kuma-VideoLAN Dev Days okuqala.
o:t2009_d: I-VideoLAN yehlukana ne-École futhi iphethwe yinhlangano yayo engenzi nzuzo.
o:t2011_d: Injini inikezwa ilayisense entsha ukuze noma iyiphi i-app, yamahhala noma cha, ikwazi ukuyifaka.
o:t2012_d: I-Kickstarter iqoqa u-£47,056 ukuletha i-VLC ku-Windows 8, RT kanye ne-Phone.
o:t2013_d: I-VLC ye-iOS ibuyela ku-App Store, imahhala kuwo wonke amazwe.
o:t2017_d: I-VideoLAN ijoyina i-Alliance for Open Media ukwakha i-codec yamahhala engenazimali zobunikazi.
o:t2018_d: I-decoder ye-AV1 iqala nomphakathi we-FFmpeg bese ngokushesha ifakwa ezipheqululini.
o:t2021_d: Iminyaka engamashumi amabili yesofthiwe yamahhala nokulandwa okungaphezu kwezigidi eziyizinkulungwane eziyi-3.5.
o:t2025_d: Ku-CES, i-VideoLAN ibonisa ukukhiqizwa nokuhunyushwa kwemibhalo engezansi ngqo kudivayisi ye-VLC 4.0.
o:t2026_d: I-Dev Days yesi-15 e-Rome, i-VLC {v} enokulungiswa kokuphepha okungu-130+, nokulandwa okuyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane eziyi-7.
o:title: VideoLAN — I-multimedia ye-open source, yawo wonke umuntu
o:v_lede: Isidlali samahhala, esisebenza ezisekelweni eziningi, esidlala cishe noma yini, esisetshenziswa amakhulu ezigidi zabantu. Sakhelwe ku-libVLC, injini efanayo abathuthukisi abayifaka kuma-app abo.
o:val1_d: Abekho abatshali-zimali futhi ayikho inkampani engemuva kwayo. Inhlangano ezimele engenzi nzuzo ngaphansi komthetho wase-France kusukela ngo-2009.
o:val2_d: Yonke imigqa yekhodi iyisofthiwe yamahhala, ekhishwe ngaphansi kwe-GPL, LGPL, BSD namanye amalayisense avulekile.
o:val3_d: Azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela, ayikho idatha edayiswayo. Hhayi manje, futhi akusoze kwenzeka.
o:val4_d: Abathuthukisi abavela emazweni angaphezu kwangama-40; i-VLC ihunyushelwe ezilimini ezingaphezu kweziyi-100.
o:vdd_h: Izinhlelo ezingu-{n}, kusukela e-Paris kuya e-Rome
o:vdd_p: Unyaka ngamunye umphakathi uhlangana izinsuku ezimbili noma ezintathu zezingxoxo nokubhala amakhodi, ngokubambisana ne-FFmpeg, x264, Kodi nabangane. I-VideoLAN iphinde ibe nedokodo ku-FOSDEM, CES, SCaLE, COSCUP kanye ne-Open Source Experience.
o:vp1_d: Amafayela, amadiski, ama-webcam, amadivayisi nokusakazwa, ngaphandle kwama-codec pack okufanele afakwe.
o:vp2_d: I-hardware decoding ezisekelweni eziningi, kusukela ku-8K HDR kuya kumalaptop amadala.

s:vlc:1: Izici, izithombe-skrini, izikhumba, izinto ezinhle kanye nohlaka lwe-libVLC.
t:about_h: Kusuka kunethiwekhi yekhempasi kuya emhlabeni wonke.
t:about_p: I-VideoLAN iphrojekthi nenhlangano engenzi nzuzo ngaphansi komthetho waseFulansi, ephethwe amavolontiya akholelwa emandleni e-open source.
t:and_2: Umtapo wemidiya, ukwabelana ngenethiwekhi nokufinyelela okukude
t:c1_p: Qala nge-Hacker Guide bese uthumela izicelo zokuhlanganisa ku-GitLab.
t:c2_p: Letha i-VLC nale webhusayithi olimini lwakho.
t:c4_p: Zama izakhiwo zasebusuku futhi usisize silungise iziphazamisi.
t:com_p: Abathuthukisi abavela emazweni angaphezu kwangama-40, abahumushi, abahloli kanye namavolontiya aphendula imibuzo nsuku zonke.
t:d_card_month: Iminikelo yekhadi yanyanga zonke isebenzisa ukubhalisa kwe-Stripe; khansela noma nini usuka kuresidi yakho.
t:d_card_note: Uzofaka ikhadi lakho ekhasini lokukhokha elivikelekile le-Stripe. VideoLAN ayiboni inombolo yekhadi lakho.
t:d_legal: VideoLAN yinhlangano engenzi nzuzo ngaphansi komthetho waseFulentshi ka-1901. Ayikho inzuzo esatshalaliswayo.
t:d_more_note: Ukhetha ukunikela ngesikhathi noma ngezingxenyekazi zekhompyutha? Abathuthukisi, abahumushi, abalobi, abahloli nabaklami bamukelekile bonke.
t:d_paypal_note: Qhubeka ku-PayPal. Akudingeki i-akhawunti ye-PayPal, alikho inani elincane, kusekelwa ukukhokha ngenyanga.
t:d_sepa_note: Kweminikelo yama-euro evela kuma-akhawunti asebhange ase-Yurophu. Uzoqinisekisa i-IBAN yakho ekhasini elivikelekile le-Stripe.
t:d_story: Azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela, ayikho inkampani engemuva kwayo. VLC yenziwa amavolontiya futhi iphethwe yinhlangano encane engenzi nzuzo. Yonke iminikelo iya ngqo kuphrojekthi.
t:d_title: Gcina VLC ikhululekile. Kuwo wonke umuntu, ingunaphakade.
t:d_wallet_note: I-Apple Pay ne-Google Pay zivuleka ekukhokheni okuvikelekile kwe-Stripe kumadivayisi asekelwayo.
t:dl_linux_p: I-VLC iphakethwe yi-distribution yakho. Khetha eyakho bese unamathisela umyalo kutheminali.
t:dl_other_p: ChromeOS, FreeBSD, OS/2, Windows Phone kanye nezinhlelo zangaphambilini.
t:dl_p: Imahhala, isayiniwe futhi ayihlanganisiwe nanoma yini enye. Sikukhethele iplathifomu yakho; shintsha ngezansi uma udinga enye.
t:dl_req_ios: iOS 9 noma kamuva · iPhone, iPad, iPod touch
t:dl_req_tv: tvOS 11 noma kamuva · Apple TV HD ne-4K
t:dl_same_app: Uhlelo lokusebenza olulodwa lwamahhala lwe-iPhone, iPad ne-Apple TV.
t:dl_src_d: Ziyakhele i-VLC ngokwakho, kunoma iyiphi isistimu.
t:dl_verify_p: Qhathanisa isigxivizo se-SHA-256 esiboniswe lapha nalesi esibalwe kukhompyutha yakho. Wonke amafayela asayinwe ngokhiye we-GPG we-VideoLAN kuma-mirror ethu.
t:dlm_p: Zonke izinhlelo, wonke amafomethi: izifaki, izingobo, izitolo zezinhlelo zokusebenza, amaphakethe nekhodi yomthombo.
t:don_h: Gcina i-VLC imahhala, kuwo wonke umuntu, phakade.
t:don_p: I-VLC ayinazo izikhangiso futhi ayilandeleli ngoba ayikudingi lokho. Umnikelo wakho ukhokhela amaseva, i-bandwidth, izinsiza zokuhlola kanye nemihlangano yabathuthukisi.
t:don_ways: Apple Pay · Google Pay · Ikhadi · SEPA · PayPal · Ukudluliselwa ebhange · Bitcoin
t:eco_bluray: Amalabhulali avulekile e-DVD namadiski e-Blu-ray kanye namamenyu.
t:eco_dav1d: Isifundi se-AV1 esisetshenziswa yiziphequluli nezinhlelo zokusebenza.
t:eco_dvblast: I-MPEG-2 TS demuxer nesakazi esisheshayo sabasakazi.
t:eco_libvlc: Faka injini ye-VLC ngaphakathi kohlelo lwakho lokusebenza, kunoma iyiphi iplathifomu.
t:eco_x264: I-encoder eyisethenjwa ye-H.264, esekela ingxenye enkulu yamavidiyo aku-inthanethi.
t:f1_p: MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, FLAC, DVD, Blu-ray, ukusakaza bukhoma… I-VLC iza nama-codec ayo, ngakho amafayela avele avuleke kalula.
t:f2_p: Ukususa ikhodi nge-GPU kuwo wonke amaplathifomu, ene-zero-copy nokuxhaswa yisofthiwe. 4K, 8K, HDR10 ne-10-bit.
t:f3_p: SRT, ASS, WebVTT, DVB kanye nemibhalo evaliwe. Yihambise nge-G ne-H kuze kube yilapho ifika ngesikhathi esiqondile.
t:f4_p: HLS, DASH, RTSP, SRT kanye ne-multicast. Phequlula i-NAS yakho nge-SMB, NFS ne-UPnP, bese usakaza ku-Chromecast.
t:f5_p: Azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela, ayikho i-akhawunti. Okubukayo kuhlala kudivayisi yakho.
t:f6_p: Ikhululwe ngaphansi kwe-GPL yinhlangano engenzi nzuzo. Yakhiwe ngamavolontiya, yaxhaswa ngemali ngabantu abanjengawe.
t:f7_p: Izikhumba, izandiso, izikripthi ze-Lua kanye nohlelo oluphelele lwezihlungi zomsindo nevidiyo.
t:ft_about: I-VideoLAN, iphrojekthi nenhlangano engenzi nzuzo, ekhiqiza isofthiwe ye-multimedia yamahhala kusukela ngo-1996.
t:ft_films: Izithombe zefilimi: Big Buck Bunny, Sintel, Tears of Steel, Caminandes, Elephants Dream © Blender Foundation, CC BY.
t:ft_light: Awekho amakhukhi · Abekho abalandeleli · I-HTML5 engagudluki
t:ft_tm: I-VLC, i-VideoLAN kanye ne-x264 yizimpawu zokuhweba ezibhalisiwe ze-VideoLAN. Umklamo wokwenziwa kabusha ongakuqinisekiswanga ngu-Paul Fleury.
t:hero_lede: Isidlali semidiya samahhala, se-open source se-Windows, macOS, Linux, Android kanye ne-iOS. Amafayela, amadiski, amakhamera ewebhu, amadivayisi kanye nokusakaza — awekho amaphakheji we-codec, azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela.
t:ios_1: Ukwabelana nge-Wi-Fi, SMB, NFS, SFTP kanye ne-UPnP
t:ios_2: I-CarPlay, Siri nokudlala kusuka ku-A kuye ku-B
t:ios_3: Idlala amafayela angenakudlalwa yinoma iyiphi enye i-app ye-iOS
t:js_lang_note: Okwamanje le sayithi itholakala ngesiNgisi, isiFulentshi, isiShayina nesi-Arabhu. Zonke ezinye izilimi ezibalwe lapha zizongezwa maduze lapho ithimba le-VideoLAN liqinisekisa ukuthi umklamo omusha usulungile.
t:js_lang_soon: I-{l} ayikatholakali okwamanje. Izongezwa ngokushesha lapho ithimba le-VideoLAN liqinisekisa ukuthi umklamo omusha usulungile.
t:lin_2: Ukucacisa kwe-VA-API kanye ne-VDPAU, Wayland kanye ne-X11
t:mac_1: Isebenza ngqo ku-Apple Silicon nakuma-Mac we-Intel
t:mac_3: Isebenza ku-macOS 10.7.5 nakuzo zonke izinguqulo ezilandelayo
t:mk_lan_p: I-NAS yegumbi lokuphumula · amafolda abiwe angu-4 · SMB
t:new_1: I-FFmpeg ithuthukisiwe kusuka ku-4.4 iye ku-8.1, kanye nemitapo yolwazi ebuyekeziwe engama-49
t:new_4: Imodi yomlaleli ye-SRT nokungena ngokhiye womphakathi we-SFTP
t:new_5: I-Windows iqala ngokushesha uma amawashi eshintsha
t:new_6: Ukuhlola izibuyekezo kusayinwe ngokhiye omusha we-RSA-4096
t:new_h: I-VLC {v} yisibuyekezo esikhulu kakhulu sokuphepha eminyakeni eminingi.
t:news_lede: Izimemezelo ezingu-{n} ezivela ku-VideoLAN, kusukela ngo-1999 kuze kube namuhla.
t:proposal_bar: Isiphakamiso sokuklama se-videolan.org — umqondo ozimele onikezwe iqembu le-VideoLAN.
t:qr_p: Khomba ikhamera yefoni yakho kukhodi ukuze uvule isitolo ngqo.
t:set_saved: Kulondolozwe kule divayisi kuphela. Awekho amakhukhi.
t:set_sub: Ukusesha, ulimi, ukubukeka nokufinyeleleka — konke endaweni eyodwa.
t:show_h: Isidlali esisodwa sayo yonke idivayisi onayo.
t:show_p: Injini efanayo, i-libVLC, isebenza kukhompyutha yakho, efonini yakho nasese-TV yakho. Uma idlala kokukodwa, idlala kukho konke.
t:sitemap_lede: Wonke amakhasi e-videolan.org adluliselwe kulesi siphakamiso: amakhasi angu-{n}, kanye nezizinda ezintsha.
t:sub2: Imibhalo engezansi: English · French · 中文 · العربية
t:t1_p: I-Media › Convert / Save iguqula ividiyo ibe yi-MP4, WebM noma MP3.
t:t2_p: Vula idivayisi yokuthwebula, khetha i-Desktop, bese ucindezela ukurekhoda.
t:t3_p: I-VLC yakha kabusha ama-index e-AVI alimele futhi idlale okulandiwe okungaphelele.
t:t4_p: Cindezela u-[ noma u-] ukuze wehlise noma usheshise isivinini, iphimbo lihlale lingashintshile.
t:t5_p: I-Shift+S (⌥⌘S ku-Mac) igcina ifulemu yamanje njengesithombe.
t:t6_p: I-Media › Stream ithumela noma yiliphi ifayela kwamanye amadivayisi ekhaya.

t:untranslated: Leli khasi alikahunyushwa okwamanje. Liboniswa ngenguqulo yalo yokuqala yesiNgisi.
t:win_1: I-hardware decoding nge-Direct3D 11, HDR10 kanye ne-10-bit
t:win_2: Kusuka ku-Windows XP SP3 kuya ku-Windows 11, ku-x64, ARM64 kanye ne-x86
t:win_3: I-ZIP ephathekayo, i-MSI ye-IT, noma i-Microsoft Store

t:x_out_p: Lesi sixhumanisi sivula i-{host}, iwebhusayithi engaphethwe yi-VideoLAN.
t:x_vl_p: Usuzovula i-{name}. Le ngxenye ye-VideoLAN ayikabi yingxenye yokuklanywa kabusha okwamanje; izothola umklamo omusha uma ukuklanywa kabusha sekuqalisiwe. Okwamanje, ivuleka ngendlela yayo yamanje.
